lessonPlan.title: QA — Image Requirement Types
lessonPlan.weeklyOverview: Disposable fixture covering every Teaching Kit image-requirement value. Never merge into production curriculum.
lessonPlan.objectives: Prove instructional image rules for required, setup-only, example-only, optional, and not-needed activities.
lessonPlan.weeklyMaterials: trays, paint, tongs, cups, mats, books, scarves, bins
lessonPlan.familyConnection: Ask which activity your child liked painting, sorting, or singing about.

books.title: Color Farm
books.author: QA Author
books.whyThisBook: Matches the disposable theme and invites talk.

songs.title: Color Song
songs.motions: Tap knees for each color word.
songs.teacherDirections: Sing slowly and invite children to join.

items.title: Paint Dot Tray
items.materials:
Paper
Paint
Cotton swabs
Tray
Towels
Smocks
items.setup: Stage paint dots on a tray with paper and swabs.
items.steps: Invite children to dab and talk about colors.
items.description: Hands-on process art that benefits from setup and finished photos.

items.title: Sorting Bin Invitation
items.materials:
Bins
Tongs
Counters
Mats
Cups
Labels
items.setup: Place three labeled bins on a low table with tongs.
items.steps: Model one sort, then step back.
items.description: Complicated hands-on setup where a tray photo helps; finished result is obvious.

items.title: Collage Sample Board
items.objective: Create a simple collage with scrap paper.
items.materials:
Paper
Glue
Scraps
Trays
Wipes
Smocks
items.setup: Offer scrap paper and glue sticks.
items.steps: Children build a collage; teachers share one achievable sample.
items.description: Finished example photo is the instructional cue.

items.title: Animal Matching Game
items.objective: Match animal pairs during a short game.
items.setup: Fan matching cards on a tray.
items.description: Obvious game — photos optional, never blocking.

items.title: Morning Circle Welcome Song
items.objective: Greet friends with a familiar welcome song.
items.steps: Sing the welcome song and wave to friends.
items.description: Circle time song — photos not needed and must not block Complete.

items.title: Scarf Freeze Dance
items.objective: Move with scarves and freeze on the cue.
items.setup: Hand out scarves in a circle.
items.description: Simple movement song — category default should be Not needed.
